title: Sequencing of T2DM patients with thirst and fatigue
description: The aim of this project was to explore the role of RNA in the pathogenesis of type 2 diabetes mellitus patients with thirst and fatigue (D-T2DM), which is a common type of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Recent studies have indicated that non-coding RNA (ncRNA) plays a key role in T2DM, but its role in D-T2DM is still largely unknown.
